{{Quote|When the Rebel Alliance seized the port city of Salline, the Empire had to move quickly to remove the infestation.|Colonel Maximilian Veers, ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="Handbook" />}}
'''Salline''' was a port [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. The city was home to a [[Government center (Salline)|government center]] and the street [[Guildhead's Way]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the site of the [[Pacification of Salline]], a battle in which [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] defeated [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] insurgents who had occupied the city.

==Description==
Salline was located on an [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] coast of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Handbook" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and served as a port.<ref name="Handbook" /> As a Chandrilan [[City/Legends|city]], it was ruled by a [[Governor/Legends|governor]] who represented the city in the planet's [[Politics|government]], the [[Chandrilan House]].<ref name="Strongholdsgov">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'' establishes that all [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilan]] [[City/Legends|cities]]—which ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' establishes Salline to be one of—were ruled by [[Governor/Legends|governors]], and that each of those participated in the [[Chandrilan House]].</ref> The city also had a [[Governing council of Salline|governing council]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. Salline contained a [[Government center (Salline)|government center]] that was situated on [[Guildhead's Way/Legends|Guildhead's Way]], a wide avenue that was at least 1.2 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in length. The government center was located near multiple docks.<ref name="Handbook" />

==History==
{{Main|Pacification of Salline}}
{{Quote|A deplorable overreaction. The governing council of Salline had protested the seizure of its citizens by the ISB secret police. The Imperial governor branded them traitors. This was the result.|Alliance leader Mon Mothma, annotation to ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="Handbook" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Salline's governing council was accused of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] by Chandrila's Imperial governor after it protested the arrest of some of the city's residents by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. As a result,<ref name="Handbook" /> sometime between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|O BBY]],<ref name="Sallinedate">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' places the publication of the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. The [[Pacification of Salline]] involves the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which was formed in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] according to the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'']]. Therefore, the Pacification must have taken place sometime in between those two [[Standard year/Legends|years]].</ref> Salline was occupied by the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The Galactic Empire responded immediately, deploying [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]], [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]], and [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]] to attack the Rebels—who had fortified themselves in the government center—around [[Chandrila (star)|sunrise]], at 0200.<ref name="Handbook" />

[[File:Veers.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Pacification of Salline was led by Maximilian Veers (pictured).]]
The attackers were [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], who brought his forces down Guildhead's Way toward Salline's government center. 1.2 kilometers from the center, the [[Walker/Legends|walker]] [[Hammer 6]] was fired upon by [[Missile/Legends|missile]] batteries that had been hidden in a building on the south side of Guildhead's Way. Veers promptly ordered the building destroyed, and the group moved on. The walkers were fired on again from another building 400 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] down the road, and Hammer 6 was damaged. Veers moved his walker, [[Hammer 8]], to the front of the group.<ref name="Handbook" />

Eventually, the colonel arrived at Salline's government center and blasted open its wall. Veers ordered the Rebels to surrender, but they instead fled to nearby docks and used high-speed [[watercraft]] to escape into an ocean. Veers called in a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] from the [[Star Destroyer]] [[Viscount (Galactic Empire)|''Viscount'']], who destroyed the fleeing Rebels seven kilometers south of Salline. Veers later wrote a report on the city's [[Pacification of Salline|pacification]], which was included in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', a manual distributed by the Galactic Empire to its [[Officer/Legends|officers]] immediately before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in<ref name="Handbook" /> 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Eventually, the [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] Alliance leader [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] obtained a copy of the handbook and noted that the Empire's response was an overreaction.<ref name="Handbook" />

==Behind the scenes==
Salline was mentioned in the [[2014]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Handbook" />
